title: bridgething App Catalog
description: A federated catalog of installable webapps for a bridgething-flashed Spotify Car Thing. Served at any source URL; the companion aggregates entries across subscribed sources.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema. Editors auto-validate when present.

schema.description: Schema discriminant. Consumers MUST refuse a catalog whose schema they do not implement.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this catalog was last regenerated.

apps.description: Installable webapps offered by this source.

recommended_sources.description: Other catalog sources this source suggests adding. Empty on most sources; the official catalog populates it as a quick-add list plus the attestation lever.

Uuid.description: Stable webapp identity. Drives upgrade-in-place and the KV namespace on the device, so it MUST NOT change across versions.

Version.description: Opaque webapp version identifier. Semver is recommended but not enforced.

Semver.description: Dotted semver, no leading 'v'. The device's libbridgething_version is reported v-prefixed on the wire; the companion strips the prefix before comparing.

Sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the artifact bytes. Integrity, not authenticity.

name.description: Display name of this catalog source.

icon.description: Square source icon for the companion's source list.

AppEntry.description: One installable webapp. Unknown keys are tolerated so a catalog that carries a property added after a client shipped still validates; every key defined here is still checked strictly.

icon.description: Hosted square icon. The publish step extracts the bundle's icon and uploads it; null until then.

screenshots.description: Captures of the app running on a device, 800x480 landscape. The store shows the first one on the listing. Omit the key entirely rather than sending an empty array.

source.description: Repository or source URL, for users who want to check it themselves.

versions.description: Published versions, newest-first. The companion installs the newest version compatible with the connected device.

AppVersion.description: One published version. Unknown keys are tolerated so a catalog that carries a property added after a client shipped still validates; every key defined here is still checked strictly.

settings.description: The bundle's settings page, hosted separately so a companion can fetch it over the internet instead of pulling it off the device over Bluetooth. Its sha256 MUST be the digest of the same bytes the bundle ships, which is what the device reports as settings_hash; a client verifies against the device's hash and falls back to the device when they disagree. Absent when the version ships no settings page.

permissions.description: Permission catalog keys this version requests (net.fetch, geo, ...). Shown at install, informational, never a gate.

role.description: Mirrors the bundle manifest's role. A launcher can take the device's launcher slot and replace the built-in hub. Absent means standard.

provides_overlay.description: Whether this version ships an overlay the device can inject over every webapp. Absent means it does not.

Extension.description: A native extension shipped inside the bundle, run by a host that has an extension host. Absent means the version is webapp-only.

desktop.description: The desktop companion runs this extension. Phones have no extension host and ignore the block.

permissions.description: Deno permission descriptors the extension is granted verbatim: all, net[:host[:port]], read[:path], write[:path], run[:binary], env[:VAR], sys[:kind], ffi[:path]. Shown before install, never a gate.

url.description: Direct download URL for the artifact.

size.description: Size of the artifact in bytes.

url.description: A catalog.v1 manifest URL the companion can subscribe to.

attested.description: True if the publishing source vouches for this URL. Editorial signal, not a trust boundary.
